name: A-NeRF
definition: A method to learn a user-specific neural 3D body model and underlying skeleton pose from unlabelled monocular videos by extending Neural Radiance Fields (NeRFs) with a skeleton to apply to time-varying and articulated motion.
summary: A-NeRF learns 3D body models from monocular videos by using skeleton-relative embeddings to handle articulated motion, distinguishing itself from residual or surface-based NeRF variants.
